content.question: Leave-one-out cross-validation is a special case of leave-p-out. What is its defining property?
options: Each fold is the size of one sample (p = 1), so the model is validated on every sample separately.
Only one fold is used for training, while all the rest are used for validation.
The validation set always contains exactly one class.
The dataset is split into exactly one training set and one test set.
content.answer: Each fold is the size of one sample (p = 1), so the model is validated on every sample separately.
